segments.ja319:1.1: Susukhaṃ vata jīvāmi, labhāmi ceva bhuñjituṃ;
segments.ja319:1.3: Paripantheva tiṭṭhāmi, kā nu bhante gatī mama.
segments.ja319:2.1: Mano ce te nappaṇamati, pakkhi pāpassa kammuno;
segments.ja319:3.1: Ñātako no nisinnoti, bahu āgacchate jano;
segments.ja319:3.3: Paṭicca kammaṃ phusati, tasmiṃ me saṅkate mano.
segments.ja319:4.1: Na paṭicca kammaṃ phusati, mano ce nappadussati;

lines: Tattha susukhaṃ vata jīvāmīti ahaṃ, bhante, imaṃ sākuṇikaṃ nissāya suṭṭhu sukhaṃ jīvāmi.
Paripanthe ca tiṭṭhāmīti apica kho yattha mama ñātakā mama saddena āgatāgatā vinassanti, tasmiṃ paripanthe tiṭṭhāmi.
Kā nu, bhante, gatī mamāti kā nu kho, bhante, mama gati, kā nipphatti bhavissatīti pucchi.
Tassa pañhaṃ vissajjento bodhisatto dutiyaṃ gāthamāha –
“Mano ce te nappaṇamati, pakkhi pāpassa kammuno;
Tattha pāpassa kammunoti yadi tava mano pāpakammassatthāya na paṇamati, pāpakaraṇe tanninno tappoṇo tappabbhāro na hoti.
Abyāvaṭassāti evaṃ sante pāpakammakaraṇatthāya abyāvaṭassa ussukkaṃ anāpannassa tava bhadrassa suddhasseva sato pāpaṃ na upalimpati na allīyatīti.
